title: scan.rs: data line after terminator was not discarded (scan/decode divergence)
description: scan.rs handle_block was not stopping when a non-zero decode_line result appeared after saw_terminator=true. This caused scan() to include bytes from data lines after the terminator in the result, diverging from decode() which stops at the terminator. Fixed: added truncate-and-break on Ok(_) when saw_terminator is true. Added regression test data_line_after_terminator_is_ignored.
close_reason: Fixed: truncate-and-break on data line after terminator; regression test added.
